reasons: Cited text supports the compliant call: § 8.2 provides successive twelve-month (not multi-year) automatic renewals, a Customer opt-out on thirty days' written notice (within the ≤30-day preferred window), and a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal, with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed.

§ 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of US CPI and three percent, matching the preferred cap, and the ninety-day notice runs against Vendor rather than imposing a notice burden on Customer, so it is not a walk-away notice window.
Deterministic check confirms a 30-day non-renewal notice window, consistent with the rationale.

Consistent with the compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed and the original paragraphs are left unchanged — the correct outcome for internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
